brief: Selling AI templates as products in 2026. The Gumroad-class playbook. Pricing, packaging, distribution.

slots.subtitle: How to turn AI prompt templates into scalable revenue streams with Gum‑style simplicity.

slots.title: AI templates
slots.subtitle: Demand for ready‑made AI tools has exploded, creating a low‑friction market for creators.
slots.insight1Body: Research forums and job boards to find recurring AI workflow bottlenecks you can solve.
slots.insight2Body: Combine related prompts into a single downloadable pack to increase perceived worth.
slots.insight3Body: Publish on Gumroad, Ko‑fi, and your own site to maximize reach.
slots.pullQuote: The easiest revenue comes from solving a problem someone else already pays to fix.

slots.title: Value‑based pricing
slots.subtitle: Set prices anchored to outcomes rather than features to capture more of the buyer’s ROI.
slots.insight1Body: Look at similar AI packs on Gumroad to gauge baseline price expectations.
slots.insight2Body: Offer personal, commercial, and enterprise tiers to match varied user budgets.
slots.insight3Body: Run short‑term discounts to collect data on price elasticity.
slots.pullQuote: Pricing is a conversation, not a guess.

slots.title: Design for instant use
slots.subtitle: Make templates downloadable, editable, and ready‑to‑deploy to lower buyer effort.
slots.insight1Body: Add a one‑page guide showing how to integrate the template into common tools.
slots.insight2Body: Commit to quarterly revisions so customers see ongoing value.
slots.insight3Body: Structure prompts into reusable blocks that can be mixed for custom solutions.
slots.pullQuote: A product is only as good as its onboarding.

slots.title: Leverage multiple channels
slots.subtitle: Combine marketplace listings, email newsletters, and affiliate programs to reach a wider audience.
slots.insight1Body: Use keyword‑rich titles and tags to appear in platform searches.
slots.insight2Body: Share links on Reddit, Hacker News, and product‑hunt for viral exposure.
slots.insight3Body: Offer 20% commissions to creators who promote your templates.
slots.pullQuote: Distribution is the silent engine of revenue.

slots.title: Automate fulfillment
slots.subtitle: Integrate Stripe and Zapier to deliver files instantly and handle refunds without manual work.
slots.insight1Body: Trigger email delivery as soon as payment succeeds.
slots.insight2Body: Embed a one‑click buy button on your site for direct sales.
slots.insight3Body: Provide FAQs and a ticket system to reduce support load.
slots.pullQuote: Automation turns a side‑hustle into a business.

slots.ctaBody: *Download the PDF and revisit the pricing formulas whenever you need a quick reminder.* *Bookmark this guide to stay ahead in the AI template market.*
